chapter_note: A long chapter dominated by Manichaean ecclesial concerns (intercession for the catechumen dead). However, embedded within is a substantial cosmological substrate narrative (segments 38-127) recounting the THREE cosmic prayers: (1) Mother of Life beseeching the Father for the First Man's rescue, (2) Living Spirit/First Expander coming with great power to deliver him, (3) Third Messenger/Ambassador redeeming the living soul out of the fleshes of death. This is genuine pre-Manichaean cosmological correspondential teaching about the structure of cosmic intercession, which the editor has used as the template for justifying ecclesial practice. The fatigue score (+5.9 ecclesial drift) confirms heavy editorial development in the second half — particularly the four-gates schema (208ff) and the extended kinsman parable (260-296) which apply the cosmic pattern to catechumen alms-giving and remembrance practice. The closing commission segments (304-322) are pure ecclesial-hortatory address. Heavy manuscript damage (85.1%) makes much of segments 143-201 unreadable.
